title: Design notes for a rate limiter
persona: You are a candidate submitting a take-home project.
context: Project facts: Token bucket rate limiter in Python backed by Redis, using a Lua script so that each check is atomic. Limit is 100 requests per minute per API key. If Redis is down, requests are allowed through (fail open). You chose this so that a Redis outage doesn't take down the API, but it means limits aren't enforced during one. It took about five hours. Clock skew between app servers isn't handled because the script uses Redis time.
